description.help: Text shown in the item menu.

kind.help: Decides which other keys the item takes (heal, weapon, bonus, ...: shown under Other keys).

uses.help: Uses before it breaks (leave out for unlimited).

repairable.help: A staff's repair may mend it (needs uses).

stealable.help: A steal ability may take it.

sellable.help: A shop that buys items takes it.
